decisions.title: v4 - 2026-10-07 21:04 EDT - bearish exits always execute
bullets: Changed: rule 3 / check.py. A 0% target (BEARISH trend) now sells the whole position even when it is below the 7.5%-of-equity no-churn band. Old engine archived as check_v3.py.

Why: ETH has been BEARISH (price and SMA7 below SMA20) but we still held ~$488 of it (-4.3% from entry) because the leftover was too small to trigger a trade. That contradicted rule 2's intent (bearish = 0%) and left us exposed to a coin our own rule says to be out of. Not based on the YouTube research (those suggestions still await user review).
Effect: sold 0.1895 ETH at $2,580.10 (~$489, realized about -$22 incl. fee). BTC unaffected (NEUTRAL, target 10% after -5 pt haircut, inside the no-churn band).

decisions.title: 2026-10-07 20:39 EDT - BTC close below $84K (signal only)
bullets: News Scanner strength 3, confirmed: BTC 8 PM close $83,286, ETH -4.7% (trend already BEARISH, no ETH buys). Gov wallet $470M move to Coinbase Prime (unconfirmed, strength 2) and CFTC plan (strength 2) ignored.

Set BTC -5 pt for 24h: target 15% -> 10%. That blocks further adds but stays inside the 7.5% no-trade band, so we don't sell right back the ~$992 bought at 8:36 PM (avoids churn). The -8% stop still protects the position.

Note: the 8:36 PM buy came right after the haircut expired, before this close was known. Recommendation 3 from the research (recompute trend once a day from the completed daily close) would have avoided that timing; still pending user decision.

list.name: Exchange Listings Scanner
highlights: Default window is 7 days; dedupe is by exchange+url+title (Alpha by alphaId). Noise filter drops campaigns, copy-trade, dividends, funding/leverage tweaks. Use `--all` to see everything.
Bithumb's 5-notice API window means hourly runs are needed so nothing gets missed.
Type classifier is keyword-based (`classify()` in scan.py). Korean: 신규 거래지원/마켓 추가 = listing, 거래지원 종료 = delisting, 거래 유의 = warning (Korean "monitoring tag"), 해제 = warning lifted.
